samples.question: Each colored field has eight same-sized dots. For each complete field, try every split into two groups of four and fit one straight line to each group. For a split let R be the larger mean perpendicular residual in pixels, A the angle difference between the fitted directions in degrees, C the larger coefficient of variation of the three along-line gaps, and S the perpendicular separation of the fitted lines. Its rail score is exp(-R/5.5 - A/14 - C/0.40) * min(1, S/28). Which color has the highest rail score? Ignore color, panel position, rotation, translation, dot size, and dot count.
